description: This file defines the Plugins_Authentication class, a parent class for authentication plugins in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for user credential validation, authentication, session management, and user data handling, along with external dependencies and error handling.

classes.name: Plugins_Authentication
classes.description: Parent class for authentication plugins, providing credential validation, user authentication, session management, user data handling, and password management functionalities.

classes.name: Plugins_Authentication_Exception
classes.description: Custom exception class for authentication-related errors.

methods.name: suppliedCredentials
methods.description: Checks if username or password POST parameters are set, indicating credentials are supplied.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Performs user authentication using provided credentials, returning user data object on success.

methods.name: _getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves and validates login credentials from POST data, with optional cookie checks.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Verifies username and password, with support for MD5 and rehashing, including advisory locking.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Destroys session data and redirects to logout URL.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Displays the login page with optional message and environment checks.

methods.name: dllValidation
methods.description: Performs DLL-level validation of user and user info objects.

methods.name: setTemplateVariables
methods.description: Sets template variables for login-related pages.

methods.name: getUserDetailsFields
methods.description: Builds user detail fields for user access pages.

methods.name: getMatchingUserId
methods.description: Retrieves user ID matching given email and login.

methods.name: validateUsersEmail
methods.description: Validates user's email address format.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email address is valid using HTML_QuickForm_Rule_Email.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user record with provided data.

methods.name: saveUserDo
methods.description: Creates or updates a user data object with provided details.

methods.name: getSignupErrors
methods.description: Returns array of signup errors.

methods.name: addSignupError
methods.description: Adds an error message to signup errors array.

methods.name: getValidationErrors
methods.description: Returns array of validation errors.

methods.name: addValidationError
methods.description: Adds an error message to validation errors array.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Returns a hash of the given password using PasswordManager.

methods.name: setNewPassword
methods.description: Sets a new password for a user identified by user ID.

methods.name: changeEmail
methods.description: Updates user's email address and timestamp.

methods.name: validateUsersLogin
methods.description: Validates login name for emptiness and duplicates.

methods.name: validateUsersPassword
methods.description: Validates password strength and confirmation.

methods.name: validateUsersData
methods.description: Validates user data including token and email.

methods.name: performPasswordCheck
methods.description: Checks password validity, including MD5 and rehashing.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks if password meets minimum length requirement.
